output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without checking if the totalSupply + initialSupply overflows uint256. If initialSupply is large, attackers can mint arbitrary large amount of tokens owned by the contract owner.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value; can overflow if _value is large, attackers can make the balanceOf[msg.sender] underflow, causing attackers to gain unexpected token.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; can overflow if _value is large, attackers can make the balanceOf[_from] underflow, causing attackers to gain unexpected token.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is calculated by dividing msg.value by buyPrice, if buyPrice is set to a large value, attackers can make the amount overflow, causing attackers to gain unexpected token.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount * sellPrice can overflow if sellPrice is set to a large value, attackers can make the amount overflow, causing attackers to gain unexpected token.
